notes.title: ARCADE VERSION
notes.content:
Hey Arcade owners!

This version of RIFF VR lets people create their own IDs to post their scores to leaderboards, separate to the Steam ID your arcade uses.

There is no progression ramp - all the content is unlocked.

Also streaming is disabled.

The point of this build is to get your customers into the game as quickly as possible to play guitar, drums or sing, or to create custome performance environments to play.
